_readme: Extended 5-6 min shot plan. Each 'ready' shot is an image-to-video job: start_frame = the brochure page cropped to the clean picture area (render/brochure-crops.py), prompt = camera move + allowed motion + fidelity constraints. Shots marked missing/blocked cannot be made faithfully from current sources.

shots.prompt: Photoreal view of Earth from high orbit at morning, the Arabian Peninsula and the Red Sea in sunlight, very slow forward drift, thin atmosphere glow. No changes to the buildings: keep facade geometry, window and door positions, lattice screens, pergolas, materials and colours exactly as in the start frame. No new buildings, floors or openings. No warping, no morphing, no flicker, no text.
